CLI scheduling, model latency, applying and validating included. Provider-reported total = input_tokens + output_tokens. Cache-read and reasoning counters included already.
method.tide: Native test --explain; apply via native edit --edits --write on the captured base revision. Public examples and 72 independent examples on a new copy per trial.
method.python: CPython -IBS under bwrap with read-only fixture. First public failure plus AST-reachable full function bodies; replacements applied at Python AST body line boundaries; public and held-out outputs verified externally.
method.tool_timings: Installed packages, one logical CPU (2), alternating order; three warm-ups followed by 19 measured processes per variant/workload (seven commands per old sequence). Prepared contexts compared structurally. Output bytes include JSON whitespace and terminating LF.
method.controls: 3 warmup rounds, 19 samples per variant on logical CPU 2, rotating order. Identical stdout and successful exit verified.
